Set Up a Recurring Deduction on Salary

User manual · English · 12 steps
Learn how to record an amount that is taken from an employee's salary every month, such as a loan or advance repayment, using a salary attachment that payslips pick up automatically.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Contracts menu

Open the Contracts menu.

3. Salary Attachments

Click Salary Attachments.

4. New attachment

Click New to create a salary attachment.

5. Employee

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

6. Choose the employee

Click the result you want in the list.

7. Description

Type a short description, then press Tab.

8. Deduction type

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

9. Choose the type

Click the result you want in the list.

10. Monthly amount

Type the amount to deduct each month, then press Tab.

11. Total amount

Type the total amount to recover, then press Tab.

Screenshot pending — run the pipeline again to capture it.

12. Save

Click the save icon to keep the attachment.
